issues.why: AC-26 mentions rate limits survive request boundaries with an 'in-memory + persisted floor' but doesn't specify the SQLite locking strategy for the floor update.
issues.fix: Specify 'BEGIN IMMEDIATE' for rate-limit increment transactions in §05.
